1.w: For the music director, according to the tune “Morning Doe”; a psalm of David. My God, my God, why have you abandoned me? I groan in prayer, but help seems far away.

2.w: My God, I cry out during the day, but you do not answer, and during the night my prayers do not let up.

3.w: You are holy; you sit as king receiving the praises of Israel.

4.w: In you our ancestors trusted; they trusted in you and you rescued them.

5.w: To you they cried out, and they were saved; in you they trusted and they were not disappointed.

6.w: But I am a worm, not a man; people insult me and despise me.

7.w: All who see me taunt me; they mock me and shake their heads.

8.w: They say, “Commit yourself to the Lord ! Let the Lord rescue him! Let the Lord deliver him, for he delights in him.”

9.w: Yes, you are the one who brought me out from the womb and made me feel secure on my mother’s breasts.

10.w: I have been dependent on you since birth; from the time I came out of my mother’s womb you have been my God.

11.w: Do not remain far away from me, for trouble is near and I have no one to help me.

12.w: Many bulls surround me; powerful bulls of Bashan hem me in.

13.w: They open their mouths to devour me like a roaring lion that rips its prey.

14.w: My strength drains away like water; all my bones are dislocated. My heart is like wax; it melts away inside me.

15.w: The roof of my mouth is as dry as a piece of pottery; my tongue sticks to my gums. You set me in the dust of death.

16.w: Yes, wild dogs surround me— a gang of evil men crowd around me; like a lion they pin my hands and feet.

17.w: I can count all my bones; my enemies are gloating over me in triumph.

18.w: They are dividing up my clothes among themselves; they are rolling dice for my garments.

19.w: But you, O Lord , do not remain far away. You are my source of strength. Hurry and help me!

20.w: Deliver me from the sword. Save my life from the claws of the wild dogs.

21.w: Rescue me from the mouth of the lion and from the horns of the wild oxen. You have answered me.

22.w: I will declare your name to my countrymen. In the middle of the assembly I will praise you.

23.w: You loyal followers of the Lord , praise him. All you descendants of Jacob, honor him. All you descendants of Israel, stand in awe of him.

24.w: For he did not despise or detest the suffering of the oppressed. He did not ignore him; when he cried out to him, he responded.

25.w: You are the reason I offer praise in the great assembly; I will fulfill my promises before the Lord ’s loyal followers.

26.w: Let the oppressed eat and be filled. Let those who seek his help praise the Lord . May you live forever!

27.w: Let all the people of the earth acknowledge the Lord and turn to him. Let all the nations worship you.

28.w: For the Lord is king and rules over the nations.

29.w: All the thriving people of the earth will join the celebration and worship; all those who are descending into the grave will bow before him, including those who cannot preserve their lives.

30.w: A whole generation will serve him; they will tell the next generation about the Lord.

31.w: They will come and tell about his saving deeds; they will tell a future generation what he has accomplished.
